raw_output:
alias: 温度合适就关空调
description: 当温度达到设定值时关闭空调
triggers:
  - platform: state
    entity_id: climate.living_ac
    to: 'off'
conditions:
  - condition: numeric_state
    entity_id: climate.living_ac
    attribute: current_temperature
    value_template: "{{ states.climate.living_ac.attributes.target_temperature }}"
    above: 25
actions:
  - service: climate.turn_off
    target:
      entity_id: climate.living_ac
mode: single
